meta.bit_reading_note: each position measures one round of disjoint pairs (rounds, by order); pair i of that round is bits 2i and 2i + 1
meta.layout: Kickoff 35's three rounds of disjoint pairs (k35-layout.json); no coupler lacked a CZ that day
meta.description: Kickoff 43, Job 1: the whole-chip map, run as one day of Kickoff 35: 12 circuits (circuit A, no offset and offset), every coupler of ibm_fez in its round, in the mirror order, 4000 shots per circuit (8000 per variant per coupler). Job 2 (k43-reuse.json) was placed by this map 3.4 minutes after it finished.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0; in each circuit, pair i of its round (in the order of rounds) is measured into classical bits 2i (its first qubit) and 2i + 1 (its second)

analysis.map_verdict_note: Manacitra v0.1.2 map rule with r_AB not measured (a Kickoff 35 map runs circuit A only): NOISE and REDUNDANT can be reached; DIAGNOSTIC cannot, so a map that repeats and is not explained by x reads NOT SETTLED here.
